description: This file contains a C++ program that performs object detection using a TensorFlow model. It includes functions for reading images, loading models, processing model outputs, drawing bounding boxes, and the main function orchestrates the detection pipeline on a specified image.

methods.name: Status ReadLocationsFile(const string & file_name,std::vector<float> * result,size_t * found_label_count)
methods.description: Reads box prior locations from a CSV file into a vector of floats.

methods.name: Status ReadTensorFromImageFile(const string & file_name,const int input_height,const int input_width,const float input_mean,const float input_std,std::vector<Tensor> * out_tensors)
methods.description: Loads an image from disk, decodes it, resizes, and normalizes it into tensors suitable for model input.

methods.name: Status SaveImage(const Tensor & tensor,const string & file_path)
methods.description: Encodes a tensor as a PNG image and writes it to disk.

methods.name: Status LoadGraph(const string & graph_file_name,std::unique_ptr<tensorflow::Session> * session)
methods.description: Loads a TensorFlow graph from a file into a session.

methods.name: Status GetTopDetections(const std::vector<Tensor> & outputs,int how_many_labels,Tensor * indices,Tensor * scores)
methods.description: Runs a TopK operation on model output tensors to retrieve the highest scoring detections.

methods.name: void DecodeLocation(const float * encoded_location,const float * box_priors,float * decoded_location)
methods.description: Decodes encoded location predictions into actual box coordinates.

methods.name: float DecodeScore(float encoded_score)
methods.description: Converts an encoded score to a probability via sigmoid.

methods.name: void DrawBox(const int image_width,const int image_height,int left,int top,int right,int bottom,tensorflow::TTypes<uint8>::Flat * image)
methods.description: Draws a bounding box around detected objects on an image tensor.

methods.name: Status PrintTopDetections(const std::vector<Tensor> & outputs,const string & labels_file_name,const int num_boxes,const int num_detections,const string & image_file_name,Tensor * original_tensor)
methods.description: Processes the output tensors to identify and visualize top detections, optionally saving an image with bounding boxes.
